'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Philippe Dubreuil DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Philippe Dubreuil]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
